Name: I put a whole bag of jellyfish up my Beach Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
Farm Features:
Seasonal Forage spawns
Beach Spawns
Can catch fishes from the beach
Grass and Stone are tillable 
Can use sprinklers on sand

you can also play the ocean ambience on this farm if you want to🗣️, just set the ocean ambience to "True" on the config 

there's also 2 starter gift options, so make sure you choose one on the config first before starting a new save

Farmer Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Preserves Jar - 1
Dehydrator - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1

Fisher Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Bait Maker - 1
Fish Smoker - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1
